items.title: Wendy Oxenhorn — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Peter Martins at New York City Ballet gave us free tickets to Nutcracker, and the girls, the ballerinas would meet them before the show

ctx.x: This is what leads up to that.

This leads up to that. Then the welfare hotels...the city cracked down and realized it was all some kind of contracting underground nightmare, and there were payoffs going on all over the place. Because the city was giving these welfare hotel owners $2000 a month per room for people to live without cooking facilities, without your own bathroom. Kids would have to go to the front desk and ask for three...they’d have to ask for toilet paper to use the bathroom. How demeaning. I mean, that was the motivating factor…
These things didn’t just happen by themselves. They happened because people, probably you, were pitching people to contribute...
